title: Aces High | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched along scenic 30A in the heart of Seagrove, Aces High is a newly constructed seven-bedroom retreat designed for effortless coastal living. Gulf views, deeded private beach access directly across the street, and a private heated pool create the perfect setting for relaxed days by the water. Inside, the thoughtfully designed layout blends style and comfort, with a spacious main living area, a beautifully appointed kitchen, and convenient elevator access to every level. With a six-seater golf cart and six bikes included, exploring the charm of 30A’s nearby beaches, cafés, and boutiques is both easy and enjoyable. The home’s multi-level floor plan provides generous space for gathering while offering privacy throughout. Three bedrooms with en-suite baths are located on the entry level, while the second floor hosts the bright main living space along with the king master suite and a convenient half bath. The upper level features three additional bedrooms, each with a private bathroom, creating comfortable accommodations for larger groups or multiple families. From mornings spent cruising along 30A to evenings unwinding by the pool after a day at the beach, Aces High offers a refined and memorable coastal escape.
